title: Metrics reference
description: Every series Relic exports on its metrics port, with its labels.

<!-- Generated by go run ./tools/metricsdoc from the registered metrics. Do not edit. -->

Relic serves these series at `/metrics` on its metrics port
(`RELIC_METRICS_LISTEN_ADDRESS`, default `:8091`), besides the Go runtime (`go_*`) and
process (`process_*`) collectors. Label values are bounded: routes are the
router's patterns, formats and classes come from fixed lists, and anything
unknown is `other`. A `repository` label marked (opt-in) appears only with
`RELIC_METRICS_REPOSITORY_LABEL=true`; the replication gauges carry it always,
one series per configured replication. Histograms also export `_bucket`,
`_sum` and `_count`, and latency histograms carry the trace ID as an exemplar.
See [Monitoring](/docs/guides/monitoring) for the dashboards and alerts.

| Series | Type | Labels | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `relic_artifact_bytes_total` | counter | `direction`, `format`, `repository` (opt-in) | File bytes deployed (direction up) and downloaded (down), by format. |
| `relic_artifact_downloads_total` | counter | `format`, `class`, `source`, `repository` (opt-in) | Full file downloads by format, class of the repository that served them, and source (local, cache, upstream). |
| `relic_artifact_uploads_total` | counter | `format`, `class`, `repository` (opt-in) | Files deployed into local repositories, by format and repository class. |
| `relic_audit_events_total` | counter | `outcome`, `result` | Audit events by outcome (success, denied, failure), and whether recording them failed (result). |
| `relic_auth_attempts_total` | counter | `method`, `result` | Authentication attempts by credential method and result (success, failure, throttled, error). |
| `relic_blob_integrity_failures_total` | counter | `problem` | Reads that found a blob missing from object storage, or stored content that does not match its digest or size. |
| `relic_build_info` | gauge | `version`, `revision`, `component` | Relic's version and source revision; always 1. |
| `relic_builds` | gauge |  | Build names with published build info. |
| `relic_builds_published_total` | counter | `result` | Build info documents published, by result. |
| `relic_cleanup_moved_total` | counter |  | Items cleanup policies moved to the trash. |
| `relic_cleanup_runs_total` | counter | `result` | Cleanup policy runs by result. |
| `relic_cve_feed_age_seconds` | gauge | `feed` | Time since each CVE feed (epss, kev) was last read. |
| `relic_db_pool_acquire_duration_seconds_total` | counter |  | Time spent acquiring connections. |
| `relic_db_pool_acquired` | gauge |  | Connections in use. |
| `relic_db_pool_acquires_total` | counter |  | Connections acquired from the pool. |
| `relic_db_pool_empty_acquire_total` | counter |  | Acquires that had to wait because no connection was idle. |
| `relic_db_pool_idle` | gauge |  | Idle connections. |
| `relic_db_pool_max` | gauge |  | The pool's maximum size. |
| `relic_db_query_duration_seconds` | histogram | `query` | Database query duration by sqlc query name (other for dynamic and migration SQL). |
| `relic_db_sqlite_file_bytes` | gauge |  | Size of the SQLite database, its write-ahead log included. |
| `relic_db_transaction_retries_total` | counter | `reason` | Transactions run again after a deadlock, a serialization failure, a busy SQLite database or a conflict. |
| `relic_deploy_checksum_hits_total` | counter | `format` | Deploys satisfied by content Relic already stored (checksum deploys), by format. |
| `relic_deps_dev_lookups_total` | counter | `result` | deps.dev lookups that missed the cache, by result (success, error). |
| `relic_disk_free_bytes` | gauge | `volume` | Free space on the volume Relic keeps data on (SQLite, the filesystem object store). |
| `relic_disk_size_bytes` | gauge | `volume` | Size of the volume Relic keeps data on (SQLite, the filesystem object store). |
| `relic_downloads_blocked_total` | counter | `reason` | Downloads refused by a scan policy, by reason (unscanned, quarantine, policy). |
| `relic_end_of_life_refreshes_total` | counter | `result` | Reads of the end-of-life data by result (changed, unchanged, error). |
| `relic_findings` | gauge | `severity` | Vulnerability findings on content stored in repositories, by severity. |
| `relic_gc_deleted_blobs_total` | counter |  | Blobs removed by garbage collection. |
| `relic_gc_deleted_bytes_total` | counter |  | Bytes reclaimed by garbage collection (the drop in unreferenced bytes over a run). |
| `relic_gc_deleted_temporary_files_total` | counter |  | Expired uploads and staging files the filesystem object store's garbage collection deleted. |
| `relic_gc_runs_total` | counter | `result` | Garbage collection runs by result. |
| `relic_http_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `family`, `route`, `method` | Time from the request's arrival to the end of its response. |
| `relic_http_request_size_bytes` | histogram | `family` | Request body bytes read, by API family. |
| `relic_http_requests_in_flight` | gauge | `family` | Requests being served, by API family. |
| `relic_http_requests_total` | counter | `family`, `route`, `method`, `code` | HTTP requests by API family, route pattern, method and status class. |
| `relic_http_response_size_bytes` | histogram | `family` | Response body bytes written, by API family. |
| `relic_http_slow_requests_total` | counter | `family` | Requests still being served 10 seconds after they arrived, by API family. |
| `relic_huggingface_xet_rebuilt_bytes_total` | counter |  | Bytes of the files Relic rebuilt from Xet xorbs into repository items. |
| `relic_huggingface_xet_shard_duration_seconds` | histogram | `result` | Time to register a Xet shard, rebuilding the files it lists, by result (success, error). |
| `relic_huggingface_xet_upload_bytes_total` | counter | `object` | Bytes of the Xet objects Hugging Face clients uploaded and Relic stored, by object (xorb, shard). |
| `relic_huggingface_xet_uploads_total` | counter | `object`, `result` | Xet objects Hugging Face clients uploaded, by object (xorb, shard) and result (success, error). |
| `relic_inventory_timestamp_seconds` | gauge |  | When the inventory series were last computed (Unix time). |
| `relic_job_duration_seconds` | histogram | `kind` | Background job duration by kind. |
| `relic_job_oldest_available_age_seconds` | gauge | `kind` | Age of the oldest job available to run, by kind (0 when none waits). |
| `relic_jobs_queued` | gauge | `kind` | Jobs available to run now, by kind. |
| `relic_jobs_retryable` | gauge | `kind` | Jobs waiting to be retried after an error, by kind. |
| `relic_jobs_total` | counter | `kind`, `result` | Background jobs worked, by kind and result (success, error, cancelled, snoozed). |
| `relic_ldap_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `directory_op`, `result` | LDAP operations (dial, bind, search) and their duration. |
| `relic_mcp_tool_calls_total` | counter | `tool`, `result` | MCP tool calls by tool and result. |
| `relic_object_storage_bytes_total` | counter | `op` | Bytes written to (put) and read from (get) object storage. |
| `relic_object_storage_op_duration_seconds` | histogram | `op` | Object storage operation duration (for get, to the start of the body). |
| `relic_object_storage_ops_total` | counter | `op`, `result` | Object storage operations by operation and result (success, miss for a key that does not exist, error). |
| `relic_operational_risks_found_total` | counter | `kind` | Operational risks found in scanned artifacts by kind (end_of_life, deprecated, unmaintained). |
| `relic_promotion_gate_decisions_total` | counter | `decision` | Promotion gate decisions by decision (allowed, refused). |
| `relic_promotions_total` | counter | `kind`, `result` | Build and release promotions by kind (build, release) and result. |
| `relic_registry_approvals_total` | counter | `decision` | Agent registry approvals by decision (approved, revoked). |
| `relic_releases_total` | counter | `op`, `result` | Release (release bundle) operations by operation (create, update, finalize, delete, export, import) and result. |
| `relic_remote_cache_total` | counter | `format`, `result`, `repository` (opt-in) | Remote repository lookups: hit (served from the cache), miss (fetched), stale (cached metadata served because the upstream failed), absent (an upstream 404 remembered), error. |
| `relic_replication_consecutive_failures` | gauge | `repository` | Failed push replication runs in a row since the last success, per replicated repository (bounded by the configured replications). |
| `relic_replication_duration_seconds` | histogram |  | Replication run duration. |
| `relic_replication_events_total` | counter | `result` | Files handled by replication, by result (pushed, pulled, skipped, deleted). |
| `relic_replication_lag_seconds` | gauge | `repository` | Time since a replication last ran, per replicated repository. |
| `relic_replication_runs_total` | counter | `result`, `repository` (opt-in) | Push replication runs by result. |
| `relic_repositories` | gauge | `format`, `class` | Repositories by format and class. |
| `relic_rpc_duration_seconds` | histogram | `service`, `method` | Relic API (Connect) call duration. |
| `relic_rpc_requests_total` | counter | `service`, `method`, `code` | Relic API (Connect) calls by service, method and Connect code. |
| `relic_rpm_repodata_duration_seconds` | histogram | `class`, `result` | Time to generate an RPM repository's repodata, by repository class and result (success, error). |
| `relic_scan_backlog` | gauge |  | Artifacts queued for Relic Scan. |
| `relic_scan_duration_seconds` | histogram | `stage` | Scanner run time by stage: catalog (Syft), match (Grype), secrets (gitleaks), misconfiguration (Trivy), license (ScanCode), model and reachability (govulncheck). |
| `relic_scanner_db_age_seconds` | gauge |  | Age of the scanner's vulnerability database (from its build time). |
| `relic_scanner_db_replacements_total` | counter |  | Vulnerability databases deleted for failing their checksum and downloaded again. |
| `relic_scans_total` | counter | `result` | Artifact scans finished, by result (done, partial, failed, skipped, queued, error). |
| `relic_secret_validations_total` | counter | `provider`, `result` | Secrets found in content checked with their provider, by provider and result (live, inactive, unknown, error). |
| `relic_storage_blobs` | gauge |  | Blobs stored. |
| `relic_storage_bytes` | gauge |  | Bytes of content stored (each blob once). |
| `relic_storage_check_findings_total` | counter | `finding` | What storage checks found: objects no blob row named (adopted for garbage collection), and blobs missing, of the wrong size or corrupt. |
| `relic_storage_check_runs_total` | counter | `result` | Storage checks by result. |
| `relic_storage_check_verified_bytes_total` | counter |  | Bytes of stored content storage checks re-hashed. |
| `relic_telemetry_errors_total` | counter |  | Errors the OpenTelemetry SDK reported, such as a failed export of spans or log records. |
| `relic_telemetry_spans_total` | counter | `outcome` | Sampled spans by outcome: ended (queued for export), exported, or failed (the export returned an error). |
| `relic_tls_certificate_expiry_timestamp_seconds` | gauge | `source` | When the certificate the server serves expires, in Unix seconds, by source (operator, generated). |
| `relic_tls_certificates_issued_total` | counter | `result` | Server certificates issued by the certificate authority Relic generated, by result. |
| `relic_tokens_issued_total` | counter | `kind` | Access tokens issued: new ones (access) and exchanges of a refresh token (refresh). |
| `relic_trash_items` | gauge |  | Entries in the trash can. |
| `relic_trash_purged_total` | counter |  | Trash can entries purged after the retention period. |
| `relic_unreferenced_bytes` | gauge |  | Bytes of content no item references, which garbage collection will reclaim. |
| `relic_upstream_duration_seconds` | histogram | `format`, `repository` (opt-in) | Time to an upstream's response headers. |
| `relic_upstream_requests_total` | counter | `format`, `code`, `repository` (opt-in) | Requests to remote repositories' upstreams, by format and status class (error when no response came). |
| `relic_users` | gauge |  | User accounts. |
| `relic_vex_exports_total` | counter | `format` | VEX documents exported by format (openvex, cyclonedx). |
| `relic_webhook_deliveries_total` | counter | `result` | Webhook delivery attempts by result: delivered, retry (failed, to be retried) or failed (given up). |
| `relic_webhook_delivery_duration_seconds` | histogram |  | Time a webhook's receiver took to answer. |
